facts.text: Full-time students pay no tuition; instead, each student works 15 hours per week at an on-campus workstation and completes two 40-hour work weeks during the academic year.

sources.title: Graduate Debt-Free | College of the Ozarks
sources.quote: Each student participates in the on-campus work program for 15 hours per week and two forty-hour work weeks per school year.

facts.text: College of the Ozarks does not participate in federal, state, or private student loan programs, providing a Tuition Assurance Scholarship combined with the student work program so undergraduates graduate debt-free.

sources.title: Graduate Debt-Free | College of the Ozarks
sources.quote: College of the Ozarks discourages student borrowing, and therefore, does not participate in the federal, state or private loan programs.
